text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray: Hyperinflation of lungs with flattened diaphragms, no infiltrates or masses. Spirometry: FEV1/FVC ratio less than 70%, indicating obstructive pattern. Reversibility test shows improvement with bronchodilator.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with a component of asthma (ACO). The combination of significant smoking and dust history, chronic cough, wheezing, and a spirometry pattern showing obstruction that is partially reversible strongly points to this. Given your factory exposure, we should also consider the possibility of chronic bronchitis superimposed on emphysema. Do you have any family history of asthma or allergies?

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Acute exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
